# Vendor Skills

This directory contains upstream-style Figma skill content copied into this repository for reference and selective reuse.

Guidelines:

- Keep the upstream folder structure intact so relative references continue to work.
- Do not treat this directory as the default project skill set.
- Copy only the official skills you actually need into a project's `.claude/skills/`.
- Prefer keeping project-specific workflow rules in `project_templates/base/` or the preset folders rather than editing vendor files directly.
